label: Lawful Good
description: A lawful good character acts as a good person is expected or required to act.

label: Neutral Good
description: A neutral good character does the best that a good person can do.

label: Chaotic Good
description: A chaotic good character acts as their conscience directs with little regard for what others expect.

label: Lawful Neutral
description: A lawful neutral character acts as law, tradition, or a personal code directs.

label: True Neutral
description: A neutral character does what seems to be a good idea.

label: Chaotic Neutral
description: A chaotic neutral character follows their whims.

label: Lawful Evil
description: A lawful evil character methodically takes what they want within the limits of their code.

label: Neutral Evil
description: A neutral evil character does whatever they can get away with.

label: Chaotic Evil
description: A chaotic evil character does whatever their greed, hatred, and lust for destruction drive them to do.
